why: Operator ruling, 2026-09-26 (compare-spec 2.16.0): a record the submission TARGETS by a Compilation, Composite or Lightweight relationship -- the film a trailer promotes, an entry of a compilation -- is related to it by assertion and is never its duplicate. Excluded from EVERY comparison, not only cross-type ones, and before scoring. Here the vendor auto-matched the submission to the very record it targets, and the two agree on every field: without the exclusion this is a clean Agree at 100. With it, the vendor's match reads as no match and a reviewer confirms. New fixture field: `related_targets` on the submitted record, `[[eidr_id, kind]]`.

notes: 1 candidate(s) excluded: the submission targets them by an explicit relationship (10.5240/FEED-0001-0002-0003-0005-K Lightweight), so they are related, never duplicates
